content:
From: Calvin Beck <hobbes@engineering.upenn.edu>
Subject: [isabelle] Call for Nominations: POPL 2027 Artifact Evaluation Committee

TLDR: Nominate students, postdocs, and researchers for the POPL 2027
Artifact Evaluation Committee by Monday, September 7, 2026 at the following
link:

https://forms.gle/7uhZuQen2vxCf2ci6

Please forward to your own students and institutions!

—

For the thirteenth year, POPL (https://popl27.sigplan.org/) is
establishing an Artifact Evaluation Committee (AEC) to promote repeatable
experiments in the POPL community. Last year, we received 49 submitted
artefacts, resulting in 2-3 artifacts assigned to each reviewer.

We are proud to announce an open call for nominations of senior graduate
students, postdocs, or research community members to serve on the POPL 2027
AEC. We also encourage self-nominations. Participants will gain insight
into the value of artifacts in academic publications, and a deeper
understanding of the evaluation process – all while helping the community
to establish and maintain norms for artifact evaluation.

We strongly encourage graduate students to serve on the AEC – the artifacts
provided use a wide range of systems and languages, and graduate students
can be particularly well equipped to handle the diversity. Furthermore, the
insight and suggestions from upcoming researchers is invaluable to
improving the artifact evaluation process.

The work of the AEC will be done approximately between the middle of
October and the middle of November (roughly four weeks), so we are looking
for people who are available during that time.

Please fill out this nomination form for each nominee by Monday, September
7, 2026:

https://forms.gle/7uhZuQen2vxCf2ci6

We look forward to your nominations! Please let us know if you have any
questions. Thank you for your help!

Calvin Beck <hobbes@seas.upenn.edu> and Emmanuel Anaya Gonzalez <
fanayagonzalez@ucsd.edu>

POPL 2027 AEC Chairs
